definitions.explanation: An unfavorable assessment or rating given to something, indicating dissatisfaction or a judgment of poor quality. Common on review sites and video-sharing platforms.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{低評価|ていひょうか}だった。
examples.english: This movie got a low rating.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}に{低評価|ていひょうか}がつく。
{商品|しょうひん}の{低評価|ていひょうか}レビューを{読|よ}んでから{買|か}うか{決|き}める。
examples.english: I decide whether to buy after reading the low-rated reviews of the product.

notes:
Composed of {低|てい} (low) + {評価|ひょうか} (evaluation, rating). Its natural antonym is {高評価|こうひょうか} (high rating).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低評価|ていひょうか}を{受|う}ける: to receive a poor evaluation
- {低評価|ていひょうか}ボタン: the dislike button (on video sites)
- {低評価|ていひょうか}レビュー: a negative review

USAGE:
Online, especially on video platforms, {低評価|ていひょうか} refers concretely to the "dislike" or thumbs-down button, as in {低評価|ていひょうか}を{押|お}す (to hit dislike).
